overview.description: The Horizon High Income ETF (YLDY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund seeks current income and capital appreciation through an actively managed portfolio of dividend-paying securities issued primarily by US large-cap issuers. It also utilizes an option strategy, selling call options on broad-based indices YLDY was launched on Aug 12, 2026 and is issued by Horizon Kinetics.

holdings.infoBox: YLDY is an equity ETF with a total of 202 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 7.24%, Apple at 6.29%, Microsoft at 5.61%, Alphabet at 5.09%, and Amazon.com at 2.98%.
